verdict: THE MEDIUM ADDS NO LENGTH OF ITS OWN: the slope RISES with neighbour order (0.205, 0.236, 0.408, 0.568), because the distance to the k-th neighbour in a cluster is set mainly by the body's own radius, which is inherited at the size and shape slopes. The order-1 gap is therefore the cleanest purely positional measure - and the weakest inherited quantity in the whole ladder.
